mechanism: Rivastigmine inhibits acetylcholinesterase increasing parasympathomimetic effects, while primaquine can cause hemolytic anemia and cardiovascular effects; combined use may potentiate cholinergic symptoms and complicate hemolytic monitoring.
action: Monitor for excessive cholinergic effects (bradycardia, hypotension, syncope) and hematologic parameters; use with caution in patients with cardiac conduction abnormalities or G6PD deficiency.
